claim_boundary.allowed: turns existing converter SPICE evidence into a concrete analog layout and extraction work order
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not create layout, does not create extracted netlists, does not fill measured values, and does not submit accepted post-layout evidence

deliverables.acceptance: extracted netlist exists, includes row DAC path, and reports positive DAC row-drive energy and settling time
deliverables.name: row_dac_layout

deliverables.acceptance: extracted netlist exists, includes sample path and SAR readout, and output noise is at or below 0.004 RMS
deliverables.name: sar_readout_layout

deliverables.acceptance: extracted netlist includes shared mux loading and preserves the 16-output sharing rule used by break-even
deliverables.name: shared_mux_layout
deliverables.target: shared converter mux and loading path

deliverables.acceptance: positive ADC and DAC area values come from the layout or extracted macro boundary
deliverables.name: converter_macro_area
deliverables.target: combined DAC, ADC, reference, mux, and sample layout boundary

deliverables.acceptance: rerun artifact uses extracted energy, latency, noise, area, and the same sharing rule as the payload
deliverables.name: same_run_break_even_rerun
deliverables.target: break-even decision using extracted converter values
